# CBS Research Portal

> Institutional research repository and academic collaboration hub for Copenhagen Business School's scholarly output, faculty research, and student theses.

CBS Research Portal serves as the central discovery and dissemination platform for Copenhagen Business School's research across all academic departments. The portal provides open access to publications, faculty profiles, department-specific research collections, and graduate student theses.

## Key Topics

- Copenhagen Business School
- institutional repository
- research output
- open access
- academic publications
- faculty directory
- student theses
- department profiles
- academic collaboration
- research database
- Department of Accounting
- Department of Finance
- Department of Economics
- Department of Digitalization
- academic research

## Main Portal

- [CBS Research Portal](https://research.cbs.dk): Main entry point for CBS Research Portal institutional repository
- [CBS Research Portal Home](https://research.cbs.dk/en/home): Home page for CBS Research Portal with publication search
- [CBS Research Portal Index](https://research.cbs.dk/en/home/index): Index page for CBS Research Portal institutional repository

## Research Collections

- [Student Theses](https://research.cbs.dk/en/studentProjects): Student thesis database and repository for CBS graduate research
- [Copenhagen Business School](https://research.cbs.dk/en/organisations/copenhagen-business-school): CBS institutional profile with research output and faculty directory

## Academic Departments

- [Department of Accounting](https://research.cbs.dk/en/organisations/department-of-accounting): Department of Accounting faculty directory and research output
- [Department of Finance](https://research.cbs.dk/en/organisations/department-of-finance): Department of Finance faculty directory and research collaboration
- [Department of Economics](https://research.cbs.dk/en/organisations/department-of-economics): Department of Economics research output and faculty directory
- [Department of Digitalization](https://research.cbs.dk/en/organisations/department-of-digitalization): Department of Digitalization faculty and research collaboration network
- [Department of Business Humanities and Law](https://research.cbs.dk/en/organisations/department-of-business-humanities-and-law): Department profile for Business Humanities and Law research
- [Department of International Economics, Government and Business](https://research.cbs.dk/en/organisations/department-of-international-economics-government-and-business): International Economics, Government and Business department profile
- [Department of Management, Society and Communication](https://research.cbs.dk/en/organisations/department-of-management-society-and-communication): Management, Society and Communication department research output
